entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: The largest and most notable of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria, home to a diverse nation of archaeologists and historians.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which New Argive lies.

entities.name: Terisian Isles
entities.description: The island chain of which New Argive is the largest.

entities.name: Treva
entities.description: The primeval dragon of New Argive.

entities.name: Prossh
entities.description: A hellkite who rules the destructive dragons of the Kher Ridges.

entities.name: Alabaster Dragons
entities.description: A serene and wise dragon nation that soars at high altitudes.

entities.name: Balduvia
entities.description: A nation that with Kjeldor formed New Argive in 2954 AR.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: A nation that with Balduvia formed New Argive in 2954 AR.

entities.name: Sheoltun Empire
entities.description: An empire based in Benfosa that conquered New Argive in 3224 AR and was pushed out in 3274 AR.

entities.name: Thabit
entities.description: A songmage who, with his summoned Serra Angels, helped the Argivians push out the Sheoltun.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A being who arrived in New Argive in 3307 AR through a time travel experiment and witnessed the aftermath of a battle.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker whose time travel experiment with Barrin brought Karn to New Argive.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A mage who conducted time travel experiments with Urza.

entities.name: King Darien XLVIII
entities.description: The king who put Stenn in charge of finding Phyrexian sleeper agents.

entities.name: Stenn
entities.description: A nobleman who, as a Phyrexian sleeper agent himself, used his position to infect Argivia.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that devastated New Argive.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A group whose agents infiltrated New Argive after the invasion.

entities.name: Sheoltun Occupation
entities.description: The conquest of New Argive by the Sheoltun Empire in 3224 AR.

events.summary: The nation of New Argive is formed by Balduvia and Kjeldor after the Ice Age.
events.quote: The nation of New Argive was formed in 2954 AR by Balduvia and Kjeldor after the end of Dominaria's Ice Age

events.summary: The Sheoltun Empire conquers New Argive.
events.quote: New Argive was conquered by the Sheoltun Empire based out of Benfosa

events.summary: The Argivians push out the Sheoltun with the songmage Thabit and his summoned Serra Angels.
events.quote: The Argivians were able to push the Sheoltun out with the aid the songmage Thabit and his summoned Serra Angels .

events.summary: Karn arrives in New Argive via a time travel experiment and finds the aftermath of a battle.
events.quote: Karn witnessed the aftermath of a grueling battle with many dead humans .

events.summary: New Argive is devastated during the second phase of the Phyrexian Invasion but recovers, then faces infiltration by Cabal agents.
events.quote: New Argive was devastated during the second phase of the Phyrexian Invasion but recovered.

events.summary: Stenn, himself a Phyrexian sleeper agent, uses his post to infect Argivia with Phyrexians.
events.quote: However, as Stenn was one himself, he used the position to infect Argivia with Phyrexians.

relations.quote: Treva , the Renewer is the primeval dragon of New Argive.

relations.note: He rules the Kher Ridges dragons, not the Alabaster Dragons.
relations.quote: The dragons of Kher Ridges are destructive predators ruled by the hellkite Prossh .

relations.note: Put in charge of discovering Phyrexian sleeper agents.
relations.quote: King Darien XLVIII put the nobleman Stenn in charge of discovering Phyrexian sleeper agents .

relations.note: Conquered it and was later driven out.
relations.quote: New Argive was conquered by the Sheoltun Empire based out of Benfosa
